class.name: DriverState
class.brief_description: What a driver does and wants now, as [method DriverServer.driver_get_state] answered.
class.description: A snapshot filled by the driver's implementation ([method DriverImplementation._get_state]) - it does not follow the driver, a holder asks again. Whatever the implementation thinks with, every field means the same: what it shows the player of the driver.

members.member: It stands at a passenger stop.
The way it is to drive its vehicle.
The steps it would take now, in the order it decided on them ([code]DriverHint[/code], [code]addons/libreloaded/driver/driver_hint.gd[/code]); empty while it is aboard no vehicle.
The next change of the speed limit [km/h] ([constant StationServer.NO_SPEED_LIMIT]: the limit ends); with no change ahead the speed limit itself.
The distance to the next change of the speed limit [m]; [code]INF[/code] with no change ahead.
The speed it may drive at now [km/h]: 0 when it is to stand, [constant StationServer.NO_SPEED_LIMIT] for no limit.
Why it keeps the train standing.
What the stop reason comes from, translated: what the vehicle misses to be ready.
How long it is to stand yet [s], 0 when no wait holds it.
What the driver is doing, translated; empty for nothing it names.
It has nothing to do but wait for an order.

constants.constant: A stop ahead - the place it is to stand at.
Its vehicle is not ready to go ([member stop_reason_details] says what is missing).
It has no order to go.
The station has not dispatched the train yet.
